usage: agentbreeder cluster connect token [-h] --server URL
                                          --mint-kubeconfig FILE
                                          --registry HOST/PATH --pod-cidr CIDR
                                          --service-cidr CIDR
                                          [--node-cidr CIDR]
                                          [--namespace NAMESPACE]
                                          [--environment ENV]
                                          [--tls-server-name NAME]
                                          [--token-minutes 10-60]
                                          [--kubectl PATH] [--json]

Check a cluster reached with short-lived service account tokens, minted with a
dedicated mint kubeconfig. Until the admission policy check is wired in (#770)
this runs every other check and then refuses, recording nothing.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --server URL          https://HOST[:PORT]
  --mint-kubeconfig FILE
  --registry HOST/PATH
  --pod-cidr CIDR
  --service-cidr CIDR
  --node-cidr CIDR
  --namespace NAMESPACE
  --environment ENV
  --tls-server-name NAME
  --token-minutes 10-60
  --kubectl PATH        kubectl to pin (default: from PATH)
  --json
